import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static class Dro implements Comparable<Dro> {
        long ch;
        long zn;

        Dro() {}

        Dro(long a, long b) {
            ch = a;
            zn = b;
        }

        void subtract(Dro a) {
            ch = ch * a.zn - a.ch * zn;
            zn = zn * a.zn;
        }

        @Override
        public int compareTo(Dro other) {
            long left = this.ch * other.zn;
            long right = other.ch * this.zn;
            return Long.compare(left, right);
        }

        void cok() {
            long j = gcd(ch, zn);
            ch /= j;
            zn /= j;
        }

        void sho() {
            System.out.println(ch + "/" + zn);
        }

        private static long gcd(long a, long b) {
            while (b != 0) {
                a %= b;
                long temp = a;
                a = b;
                b = temp;
            }
            return a;
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        long x = scanner.nextLong();
        long y = scanner.nextLong();
        long n = scanner.nextLong();
        scanner.close();

        Dro na = new Dro(x, y);
        Dro os = new Dro(50, 1);
        Dro ot = new Dro();

        for (long i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
            long r = (na.ch * i) / na.zn;
            long z = (na.ch * i) % na.zn;
            if (z > (na.zn / 2)) {
                r++;
                z = na.zn - z;
            }
            Dro p = new Dro(z, i * na.zn);
            if (p.compareTo(os) < 0) {
                os.ch = p.ch;
                os.zn = p.zn;
                ot.ch = r;
                ot.zn = i;
            }
        }
        ot.sho();
    }
}
